text: With the earlier promise in view, the difference is lessened. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and that very promise is made the matter of a test. All depends upon one word. Abraham speaks _hineni_, "here I am," three times, first to God, then to Isaac, then to the angel; the answer is the same in sound, yet each occasion changes its meaning and raises its cost, making presence itself part of Abraham's loss.
